task: Write a due diligence memo on Canva

nimble.claim: Canva founders: Melanie Perkins (CEO), Cliff Obrecht (COO) and Cameron Adams (Chief Product Officer); founded 1 January 2013 in Perth, Australia, headquartered in Sydney.
Canva CFO Kelly Steckelberg joined in November 2024; previously CFO of Zoom (through its IPO), CFO and CEO of Zoosk, divisional CFO at Cisco, began career at KPMG.
Canva other named executives per Clay dossier (may lag): Zach Kitschke (CMO) and Todd Carpenter (Chief Legal Officer & Corporate Development).

Four senior Canva leaders left in May 2026 amid AI repositioning: growth lead Iain Dowling (8 years), senior engineering director Jonathan Ross, and reportedly head of design Andrew Green and CTO Brendan Humphreys; staff concerns about job security reported.

Canva raised about $569M in primary equity across 11 rounds from 2013 to 2021; last primary round was $200M in September 2021 led by T. Rowe Price (with Franklin Templeton, Sequoia Capital Global Equities, Bessemer, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, Blackbird, Felicis, AirTree) at a $40B valuation; no new primary money since.

Canva secondary sales: ~$100M Blackbird sale to Coatue and ICONIQ at $25.5B (Aug 2023); ~$1.6B Goldman Sachs-run staff/early-investor sale at ~$26B (Mar-Apr 2024); trades at $32B (Oct 2024); over $2B of existing shares sold since 2023, none to the company.
August 2025 Canva employee share sale led by Fidelity with JPMorgan Asset Management participating priced Canva at $42B.
In 2026 investors marked Canva at $34.9B-$39.3B; Canva's own independent valuation for its August 2026 employee share issue fell ~20% year over year to $31B.

Canva is private with no IPO filing; COO Cliff Obrecht told Bloomberg in Nov 2025 Canva will go public in the next 'couple of years' (reportedly 2027); Canva ruled out an Australian listing in September 2025.
Canva operates a freemium SaaS model with drag-and-drop design; added print services and video editing over time.

Canva Enterprise offers API access, two-way DAM sync (Bynder, Widen, Brandfolder), Salesforce and HubSpot apps, Marketo/Eloqua integrations; Canva cites a Salesforce case study of 66% lower cost per design.
Canva launched Canva Enterprise in May 2024 alongside Work Kits, Courses and AI capabilities.
Canva operates in over 190 countries, supports 100+ languages, Canva AI available in 16 languages across 31 locales; majority of business is from North America.
Canva group subsidiaries include Pixabay, Pexels, Serif (Affinity), Kaleido, Leonardo.AI, Smartmockups, Flourish, Cavalry, MangoAI, Simtheory and Ortto.
In February 2025 Canva reorganised so a new Delaware company, Canva, Inc., became ultimate holding company; the former parent became Canva Australia Holdings Pty Ltd.
Canva claims 265M+ monthly active users and 31M+ paid users in 2025, with MAU up 20% year over year.
Canva claims $4B ARR at end of 2025; B2B business (companies with 25+ seats) grew 100% to $500M ARR, per COO Cliff Obrecht.
Canva says it is trusted by 95% of the Fortune 500; Expedia Group, Airbnb and Salesforce are listed enterprise customers.
Canva's AI mini-apps and website builder tool has more than 10 million monthly active users (company claim).
Canva is integrated with ChatGPT and Claude; by October 2025 users logged 26M+ conversations with the Canva app on ChatGPT, and Canva claims to be a top-10 referred domain from ChatGPT.
Canva announced print partnerships with FedEx Office (June 2020) and Office Depot (July 2020).

Canva acquisitions include Zeetings (2018), Pixabay and Pexels (2019), Kaleido.ai and Smartmockups (2021), Flourish (2022), Serif/Affinity for ~$380M (March 2024), Leonardo.AI (2024), MagicBrief (June 2025), Cavalry and MangoAI (Feb 2026), Simtheory and Ortto (April 2026).
Canva released Visual Suite 2 (Sheets, Code, chatbot) on 10 April 2025; Canva AI 2.0 in research preview with agentic tools in April 2026; offline mode in August 2026.

In August 2026 Canva cut its revenue growth forecast by a third (30% to 20%) due to unexpectedly high AI serving costs; CEO Melanie Perkins said cost per AI task fell nearly 90% since Canva AI 2.0 launched but users create three times as many designs; rollout slowed while architecture is rebuilt.

Canva raised prices steeply with genAI features (five-person annual Teams plan from $120 to $500) and reversed the hike, restoring legacy pricing for small-business and education customers after backlash.

May 2019 Canva data breach by GnosticPlayers exposed ~137.5M user records (names, emails, password hashes, some Google tokens); ~4M cracked passwords circulated in January 2020, prompting forced resets.

Canva was reportedly fined A$800,000 for late lodgement of financial reports in Australia (secondary citation via Herald Sun, unverified); commentary notes Canva's profitability cannot be verified from filed accounts.
Sacra estimates Canva ARR of $4B at end of 2025, up 43% from $2.8B at end of 2024; Canva's own recap reported $3.5B FY2025 revenue.
Canva claims nine years of free-cash-flow profitability and $1.47B cash at end of June 2026 (Sacra says 7 years of profitable operation; figures conflict).
Canva headcount was 5,500 employees in 2024 per Wikipedia citing AFR; LinkedIn shows 1,001-5,000 range.
Canva cut 10 employees in AI-related job cuts around 2 April 2025; otherwise hiring-positive, with 1,128 new hires in a year and UK team scaled from 100 to 250+.

Canva Glassdoor rating 4.1/5 (career opportunities 3.1, work/life balance 3.4, comp and benefits 3.5, culture 3.8, diversity 3.8; 384 reviews in last 6 months); reviews cite favouritism and leadership-staff disconnect.
Affinity (Serif) acquisition by Canva sparked concern and protest among parts of the Affinity user community on Reddit.
Critical press frames Canva's May 2026 senior departures, AI-credits model shift, delayed IPO and AI-linked price rises as signs of strain in its AI pivot.
Canva reportedly settled an unfair dismissal case brought by a senior engineer (AFR, 10 April 2024; secondary citation).
Canva's Feb 2025 Delaware restructure was covered by ATO class ruling CR 2025/35 on scrip-for-scrip roll-over for stock options, issued 28 May 2025.

exa.claim: Canva leadership: Melanie Perkins is CEO/co-founder, Cameron Adams is CPO/co-founder and Zach Kitschke is CMO (official leadership page as of 2026-10-21).
Canva co-founder Cliff Obrecht is COO (TechCrunch, 2026-02-18).
Canva founder backgrounds: Melanie Perkins and Cliff Obrecht previously launched Fusion Books in 2007; Cameron Adams was formerly a lead designer at Google.
Canva head of design Andrew Green announced his departure in April 2026 (joined October 2018 after roles at SEEK) and will remain an adviser.

AFR reported (2026-05-18) that Canva growth lead Iain Dowling resigned after eight years and senior engineering director Jonathan Ross would leave at end-May 2026; involuntary termination not established.

Canva announced a US$200 million funding round at a US$40 billion valuation on 2021-09-15, led by T. Rowe Price, with Franklin Templeton, Sequoia Capital Global Equities, Bessemer, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, Blackbird, Felicis and AirTree participating.
Reuters reported Canva launched an employee share sale at a US$42 billion valuation on 2025-08-20; this is secondary liquidity, not new capital, and final close/proceeds were not verified.

Forbes Australia reported lower investor marks for Canva as of 2026-06-30: T. Rowe Price implied US$38.2 billion, Franklin Templeton US$39.3 billion and Blackbird US$34.9 billion, versus the US$42 billion August 2025 employee sale.
Canva sells an online visual-communication and collaboration platform covering presentations, documents, whiteboards, video, websites, spreadsheets and AI-assisted content creation.
Canva uses a freemium subscription model: Free, Pro for individuals, per-person Business, and sales-led Enterprise; eligible schools and nonprofits get premium features free.
Canva claims to serve enterprises, small businesses, consumers and students in more than 190 countries.
Canva's majority of business comes from North America, with lower-priced subscriptions offered in markets including Pakistan, Uruguay, Morocco and Jamaica (TechCrunch, 2026-02-18).
Canva reported more than 265 million monthly active users and 31 million paid users at end-2025; MAU grew 20% during 2025 (company claim via TechCrunch).
Canva claims use by 95% of the Fortune 500; named Enterprise customers include FedEx, Salesforce, Expedia, Reddit, Docusign and Zoom (as of 2025-06-11).
Canva Enterprise go-to-market partners include resellers SoftBank and CDW, agency Designit and consultancy Deloitte; integrations include LinkedIn and HubSpot.
Canva claims 100 million teachers, students and administrators use it (2026-10-05) and is expanding email-less student accounts worldwide; not equivalent to paid growth.
Canva red flag: reported AI-cost-related rollout delays and a reduced 2026 growth forecast accompany investor valuation markdowns below the last employee-sale price.
Canva red flag: leadership continuity risk from reported design, growth and engineering departures during 2026; common cause or involuntary exits not established.
Canva reported 2025 revenue of US$3.5 billion in its 2025 year-in-review (unaudited company claim).
Canva COO Cliff Obrecht said end-2025 ARR reached US$4 billion, and B2B customers with more than 25 seats contributed US$500 million ARR, up 100%.
Canva claimed (2025-11-04) it remained profitable with US$3.5 billion annualized revenue; net income and margins not quantified.
Canva claimed its global team expanded nearly 40% (2025 CNBC Disruptor announcement); comparison period and absolute headcount not specified.
Forbes Australia, citing AFR, reported Canva told investors in July 2026 to expect 20% revenue growth for 2026 rather than an earlier 30%, alongside product-rollout delays linked to rising AI costs.

ASIC: Canva Pty Ltd, Canva Operations Pty Limited, Canva Trading Pty Ltd and Fusion Books Pty Ltd each paid A$198,000 (total A$792,000) in infringement notices for allegedly failing to lodge FY2024 financial reports by 2025-04-30; the report was lodged 2026-03-27; not an admission of liability.
ASIC states the Canva Australian group restructured after 2024 and Canva Australia Holdings Pty Ltd lodged its FY2025 reports on time on 2026-04-30.

Delhi High Court on 2026-01-28 dismissed Canva's appeal against an interim patent injunction restricting its Present and Record feature in India, upholding INR50 lakh security for past use; findings are prima facie with merits left for trial.

Capital Brief reported competing Los Angeles Superior Court lawsuits between Canva and music-rights contractor Crunch Digital in September 2026: Canva alleged confidential-data disclosure; Crunch alleged breach/non-payment (allegations only).

Canva's May 2019 breach: attackers accessed profile data for up to 139 million users on 2019-05-24; about four million account passwords were decrypted and unchanged passwords were reset on 2020-01-12.

UpGuard reported (2025-06-09) that a My Jedai AI-chatbot database exposed survey responses linked to 571 unique Canva Creator email addresses; remediated after notification; third-party exposure, not a direct Canva breach.
Glassdoor shows Canva at 3.8/5 from 904 reviews, with 69% recommending Canva and 86% approving of the CEO (as of 2026-10-21).
Recent Glassdoor reviews of Canva mix praise for coworkers, benefits and learning with complaints about favoritism, bureaucracy and inconsistent leadership.
In October 2024 Canva acknowledged planned Teams pricing changes felt too sudden to some early adopters, retained their original pricing and promised advance notice of future changes.

firecrawl.claim: Canva is an online design and publishing tool launched in 2013 with the mission of empowering everyone to design anything and publish anywhere.
Canva uses a freemium/subscription model with Free, paid Pro and Business plans, and custom-priced Enterprise.
Canva's Visual Suite combines Docs, Emails, Sheets, Whiteboards, Presentations, Social, Video, Websites and landing pages with Canva AI embedded across workflows.
Canva says K-12 organizations and nonprofits can access most premium features for free.
Canva operates in 190+ countries and 100+ languages, with localization via local templates, elements, payment methods and partnerships.
Canva Enterprise is positioned for large organizations needing centralized brand control, administration, reporting, security, collaboration and integrations.
Company claim: Canva reported 260 million monthly users and $3.5 billion in revenue in 2025.
Company claim reported by TechCrunch: Canva ended 2025 with more than 265 million monthly active users, over 31 million paid users and $4 billion ARR.
Canva's business serving companies with more than 25 seats reached $500 million ARR after 100% growth, per company claim reported by TechCrunch.
Company claim: Canva is used by 95% of the Fortune 500 and by thousands of companies through Canva Enterprise.
Named Canva Enterprise customers include FedEx, Keller Williams and DocuSign.
Canva reported FedEx deployment across 1,400 teams in 45 countries.
Canva reported DocuSign saved $300,000 in design hours using Canva.
Company claim: 100 million teachers, students and education leaders used Canva monthly in 2025 across 190+ countries.
Canva said it added more than 700,000 non-English templates and 2.3 million local elements in six months.
In Japan, Canva partnered with Irasutoya to add over 20,000 illustrations.
Canva's Salesforce case study claims use across 140+ social accounts, 22 regions and 18 languages, with a 63% increase in design production and 66% lower cost per design.
Canva's founding team is Melanie Perkins (CEO), Cliff Obrecht (COO) and Cameron Adams (Chief Product Officer).
Before Canva, Melanie Perkins and Cliff Obrecht built Fusion Books, an online school-yearbook design business; Cameron Adams joined as technology co-founder after an introduction by Lars Rasmussen.
Kelly Steckelberg joined Canva as CFO in November 2024 after serving as Zoom CFO; earlier she held finance roles at Cisco and was CEO of Zoosk.
Javier Soltero left Canva's operating enterprise role in May 2024 after about six months and returned to an adviser role; he previously held senior roles at Google and Microsoft.
Canva announced a $15 million Series A in October 2015 led by Felicis Ventures, with Blackbird Ventures and Matrix Partners participating, at a $165 million valuation.
Canva raised $15 million in September 2016 in a round led by Blackbird Ventures and Felicis Ventures at a $345 million valuation.
Canva announced a $40 million round in January 2018 at a $1 billion valuation, with Sequoia China joining Blackbird and Felicis; Blackbird partner Rick Baker led.
Canva raised $70 million in May 2019 at a $2.5 billion valuation.
Canva raised $85 million in October 2019 at a $3.2 billion valuation; investors included Bond, General Catalyst, Bessemer, Blackbird and Sequoia China.
Canva announced a $60 million round in June 2020 at a $6 billion valuation, with Bond and Blackbird quoted and no single lead identified.

Canva announced a $200 million round on September 15, 2021 led by T. Rowe Price at a $40 billion valuation; participants included Franklin Templeton, Sequoia Capital Global Equities, Bessemer, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, Blackbird, Felicis and AirTree.

Canva launched an employee stock sale in August 2025 at a $42 billion valuation, led by Fidelity Management with JPMorgan Asset Management joining; share count undisclosed and it was a secondary liquidity transaction, not a disclosed primary raise.
Reuters reported Canva's annualized revenue at $3.3 billion during the 2025 employee share sale.

Canva FY2022 revenue rose 57% to $962 million, with a $222 million statutory loss driven largely by $482 million of employee-benefit expense; cash rose to $420 million; excluding share-based payments the company made a $260 million profit.
Company claim: Canva says it has been profitable on an operating free-cash-flow basis for several years and had surpassed $3.4 billion in annualized revenue.
Canva had more than 5,000 staff worldwide and reportedly added about 1,000 employees in 2024.

10 of Canva's 12 technical-writing staff were made redundant in late March 2025; Canva described it as engineers taking greater ownership of documentation, while the report linked it to an AI-driven workflow shift.

ASIC issued A$792,000 in infringement notices to four Australian Canva Group companies (A$198,000 each) for allegedly failing to lodge FY2024 financial reports by the 30 April 2025 deadline; payment is not an admission of liability.
DigiMedia Tech, LLC v. Canva Pty Ltd, a patent-infringement action in E.D. Texas, was filed August 18, 2025 and was not shown as terminated in the retrieved docket.

Canva disclosed a May 24, 2019 security incident in which profile-database information for up to 139 million users was accessed; partial payment-card files were viewed with no evidence of theft; Canva reset OAuth tokens and prompted password changes.
Canva later said approximately 4 million passwords from the 2019 incident had been decrypted and shared online, and it reset passwords users had not changed.

Glassdoor shows Canva at 3.8/5 from 904 reviews, 86% CEO approval and 61% positive business outlook, with senior management (3.1) and career opportunities (3.1) scoring weakest and diversity and inclusion (4.1) strongest.
Recent anonymous Glassdoor reviews (May 2026 former employee, January 2026 current employee) alleged leadership problems, churn, low ownership and inconsistent decision-making.
Indeed shows Canva at 4.3/5 from 32 reviews, with 3.7/5 for pay and benefits and job security/advancement.
BBB shows 171 Canva complaints in the last three years and 77 in the last 12 months.
Trustpilot shows Canva at 4.0/5 from 7,884 reviews, with recurring criticism of unintuitive editing, slow customer-support response and print alignment.

Fox Business reported customer backlash to Canva Teams price increases in September 2024, with annual pricing rising from $119.99 to $300 and then $500 in examples; Canva said the change reflected expanded product experience and tools.
People Matters reported the technical-writer cuts unsettled Canva employees who said they had been encouraged to adopt AI and reassured it would not cause layoffs.

Forbes Australia reported 2026 investor marks on Canva were cut from the $42 billion 2025 valuation, including Blackbird's mark to $34.9 billion and T. Rowe Price's implied valuation to $38.2 billion.
